Stiff Diagram

Source: R/plotting.R
stiff_plot.Rd

Creates Stiff diagrams for visualization and comparison of major-ion water chemistry.

Usage

stiff_plot(df, ...)

# S3 method for class 'data.frame'
stiff_plot(df, location, analyte, result, unit, sample_date, ...)

# S3 method for class 'env_schema'
stiff_plot(
  df,
  analyte_matching = c("exact", "strict", "normalized"),
  calcium = "Calcium, dissolved",
  magnesium = "Magnesium, dissolved",
  sodium = "Sodium, dissolved",
  potassium = "Potassium, dissolved",
  chloride = "Chloride, total",
  sulfate = "Sulfate, total",
  alkalinity = "Alkalinity, total (lab)",
  scale_analyte = NULL,
  group_var = NULL,
  facet_var = NULL,
  stiff_limit = NULL,
  stiff_breaks = 1,
  lines = FALSE,
  title = NULL
)

Arguments

df

A data frame or `env_schema` object.

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

location

Location identifier column.

analyte

Analyte column.

result

Analytical result column.

unit

Reporting unit column.

sample_date

Sample date column.

analyte_matching

Analyte matching strategy. One of `"exact"`, `"strict"`, or `"normalized"`.

calcium

Calcium analyte.

magnesium

Magnesium analyte.

sodium

Sodium analyte.

potassium

Potassium analyte.

chloride

Chloride analyte.

sulfate

Sulfate analyte.

alkalinity

Alkalinity analyte.

scale_analyte

Optional analyte used to scale polygon fill.

group_var

Variable used to split the data into individual Stiff diagrams.

facet_var

Variable used for faceting within each plot.

stiff_limit

Maximum absolute x-axis extent expressed in milliequivalents per liter (meq/L). If `NULL`, the limit is determined automatically from the data.

stiff_breaks

Grid spacing used for x-axis and reference lines.

lines

Logical. If `TRUE`, horizontal reference lines are drawn through each ion category.

title

Optional plot title.

Value

A named list of ggplot objects. One Stiff diagram is produced for each value of `group_var`.

A named list of ggplot objects. One Stiff diagram is produced for each value of `group_var`.

Details

`stiff_plot()` is an S3 generic that supports both raw data frames and `env_schema` objects.

For data frames, environmental column mappings must be supplied. For `env_schema` objects, mapped schema fields are used automatically.

For data frames, `stiff_plot()` first converts the supplied data to an `env_schema` object using the specified column mappings and then dispatches to [stiff_plot.env_schema()].

Stiff diagrams display major-ion chemistry as a polygon whose shape reflects relative ionic composition.

Major-ion analytes are converted to milliequivalents per liter (meq/L) and transformed into standard Stiff-diagram coordinates.

Cations are plotted on the left side of the diagram and anions are plotted on the right side.

Similar polygon shapes generally indicate similar hydrochemical characteristics, making Stiff diagrams useful for evaluating:

  • spatial variability;

  • temporal trends;

  • groundwater mixing;

  • hydrochemical facies;

  • geochemical evolution.

For `env_schema` objects, analyte, result, unit, sample_date, and location fields are obtained directly from schema mappings.

Analyte Matching

exact

Uses analyte names exactly as reported.

strict

Applies text normalization while preserving analytical distinctions such as dissolved versus total fractions.

normalized

Resolves analyte aliases to canonical analyte names using package analyte metadata.

Grouping

`group_var` controls how data are divided into separate Stiff diagrams.

By default, one plot is generated per location.

If `group_var` is set to the mapped sample_date field, one plot is generated per sampling event.

Faceting

`facet_var` controls the panels displayed within each Stiff diagram plot.

By default, individual sampling events are shown as separate facets.

Scaling

When `scale_analyte` is supplied, polygon fill colour is scaled using values of the selected analyte.

This is often useful for displaying Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) or another indicator parameter alongside hydrochemical facies.

Examples

data(gw)

stiff_plot(gw)
